latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – prioritize learning goals and risk validation before customer conversations

- Enables identification and classification of business risks as product risk vs market risk
- Surfaces hidden risks and assumptions using diagnostic questions
- Supports prioritizing top 3 learning goals for upcoming conversations
- Helps founders separate must-validate assumptions from lower-priority or safer ones
- Designed specifically for the pre-conversation planning phase; directs users to other skills when writing questions or analyzing completed interviews
